SELECT cls, CAST(fish_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS doy_bucket,
       SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS ypa, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=6 AND fish_date_doy<=60
GROUP BY cls, doy_bucket
ORDER BY doy_bucket, cls

SELECT index_id, value, avail_season, avail_doy
FROM climate
WHERE index_id='oni'
ORDER BY avail_season DESC, avail_doy DESC
LIMIT 8
